contrast.reason: The sampled catalog text sits over gradients/images/translucent layers rather than an unambiguous opaque solid CSS background, so the automated solid-background calculation intentionally did not fabricate a contrast ratio. Exact contrast remains for screenshot/device-aware tooling.

limitations: PASS covers the current canonical Store runtime/manifest at the audited hashes, not staged or replacement art that is not yet canonical.
Physical iPhone/iPad/Android performance is NOT TESTED; frame and scroll measurements are headless Chromium emulation.
VoiceOver/TalkBack/NVDA are NOT TESTED; browser semantics, focusability, labels, keyboard activation and focus reachability were verified.

Exact rendered color contrast is NOT TESTED because the automated solid-background sampler could not derive valid ratios through gradient/image/translucent backgrounds; screenshot/device-aware contrast tooling is still required.

Lighting, wall, rugs and decor had no canonical image-backed cards at this manifest version; seating and desks each had only their currently canonical first image. Their staged art is outside this PASS until Workstream 08 integrates it.
The catalog gate remains unapproved because independent visual acceptance and canonical integration of pending art are separate requirements.
nextAction: Rerun the changed-collections plus stable-control gate immediately after the next Workstream-08 canonical art integration; reserve another full 16-collection sweep for a coherent catalog milestone or final gate.
